assertion_results.evidence: Task 1 covers both files. No store-level test checks that stable IDs are unchanged. 'IDs unchanged' appears only in the writer test requirements (sync, import, refresh). assertion_results.text: Implementation tasks specify path-specific validation: registration persists the supplied ownerGroup, scheduled sync/fallback/on-demand updates preserve an existing value when omitted and apply a supplied replacement, and both consumers expose values from all four writers
assertion_results.evidence: Registration ('persists the supplied ownerGroup'), fallback import ('uses ownerGroup from exported data when present, and otherwise keeps the existing value'), on-demand refresh ('refresh without ownerGroup keeps it; refresh with a new ownerGroup updates it'), and both consumers ('for records populated through each of the four writers') are all specified. Scheduled sync is the gap. Its acceptance criterion says only that it 'keeps the existing ownerGroup when refreshing a record that has one', and its test says only that sync 'leaves it unchanged'. No path-specific check covers sync applying a supplied replacement. That behavior is implied only through the shared merge helper.
